summary: Preserve protected, evidentiary, external, and unclassified artifacts while reclaiming only conclusively owned ephemerals after retention and safety gates pass.
enforcement: Never destructively delete user-owned, authoritative, evidentiary, externally owned, or unclassified data without explicit authorization. Register PACIFY-X-owned ephemerals when created and reclaim them only after ownership, ended-run, recovery, active-reference, evidence-promotion, allowed-root, link-safety, and receipt checks all pass. Intake sources still require explicit closure, two matching full-tree snapshots, and an immediate equality check. Unknown means retain.
